question: A function \(y=f(x)\) is said to be convex if the line segment joining any two points \(A=(x_1,f(x_1))\) and \(B=(x_2,f(x_2))\) on the graph of the function lies above the graph. Such a line may also touch the graph at some or all points. Only one of the following four functions is not convex. Which one is it?
